wiki.title: Liz Stefanics
wiki.extract: Elizabeth T. Stefanics (born November 9, 1950) is an American politician from New Mexico, currently serving in the New Mexico Senate and previously on the Santa Fe County Commission. She was the first openly LGBT member of the New Mexico legislature, serving a single four-year term that began in January 1993. Stefanics is a progressive senator.
